issue.title: [Bug]: aws_db_proxy_default_target_group: removing init_query is never applied (perpetual diff)
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
Terraform 1.15.x / hashicorp/aws 6.58.0 (code on `main` has the same logic)
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

- `aws_db_proxy_default_target_group`

### Expected Behavior

Removing `init_query` from `connection_pool_config` (or setting it to `""`) should clear the initialization query on the RDS Proxy default target group, and the following `terraform plan` should show no changes.

### Actual Behavior

`terraform apply` succeeds, but the initialization query remains set on the target group (confirmed with `aws rds describe-db-proxy-target-groups`). Every subsequent `terraform plan` shows the same in-place update (`init_query: "SET ..." -> null`), i.e. a perpetual diff.

### Relevant Error/Panic Output

No error output. terraform apply completes successfully.

### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

```hcl
# step 1
resource "aws_db_proxy_default_target_group" "test" {
  db_proxy_name = aws_db_proxy.test.name

  connection_pool_config {
    init_query = "SET x=1, y=2"
  }
}

# step 2: remove init_query and apply
resource "aws_db_proxy_default_target_group" "test" {
  db_proxy_name = aws_db_proxy.test.name

  connection_pool_config {}
}
```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

1. `terraform apply`
2. Remove `init_query`, `terraform apply` (succeeds)
3. `aws rds describe-db-proxy-target-groups --db-proxy-name <name>` still shows `InitQuery`
4. `terraform plan` shows the removal again

### Debug Logging

_No response_

### GenAI / LLM Assisted Development

Claude Code (Anthropic) was used to investigate the provider source and draft this report. The reproduction and the AWS CLI verification were performed manually.

### Important Facts and References

`expandConnectionPoolConfiguration` only sets `InitQuery` when the value is non-empty:

https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/blob/main/internal/service/rds/proxy_default_target_group.go

```go
if v, ok := tfMap["init_query"].(string); ok && v != "" {
    apiObject.InitQuery = aws.String(v)
}
```

`ModifyDBProxyTargetGroup` treats an omitted `ConnectionPoolConfig.InitQuery` as "no change", so the query is never cleared. Sending an empty string is required to clear it. Verified with the AWS CLI:

```console
$ aws rds modify-db-proxy-target-group --db-proxy-name <name> --target-group-name default \
    --connection-pool-config 'MaxConnectionsPercent=100,MaxIdleConnectionsPercent=50,ConnectionBorrowTimeout=120,InitQuery=""'
# response shows "InitQuery": ""
$ aws rds describe-db-proxy-target-groups --db-proxy-name <name> --query 'TargetGroups[0].ConnectionPoolConfig'
# InitQuery is no longer present
```

`session_pinning_filters` has the same `v.Len() > 0` guard and presumably the same symptom.

### Would you like to implement a fix?

Yes
